analysis.evidence: The phrase בְּנֵי נֹחַ introduces Noah as the father of the three sons named immediately afterward, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
analysis.morphology: Hebrew proper noun with no prefix or suffix. It follows the construct plural בְּנֵי in בְּנֵי נֹחַ.

analysis.evidence: The phrase בְּנֵי נֹחַ introduces Noah’s sons, and שֵׁם is the first of the three names in שֵׁם חָם וָיָפֶת.
analysis.morphology: Hebrew proper noun with no prefix or suffix.
